landing.tagline: Emerging-Tech Skills, Built for Every Community
landing.heroSubtitle: Real training in AI, cybersecurity, data science and other in-demand skills. Earn W3TR as you learn, teach and contribute.
landing.step1Body: Take mobile-first courses from instructors teaching real, practical digital skills.
landing.step2Body: Apply what you learn to real projects, not just theory. Build things that matter for your community and your career.
landing.step3Body: Earn W3TR rewards and a verifiable certificate employers can actually check.
landing.ctaSubtitle: It's free to start, and takes less than a minute.
landing.countryReadyHeading: Built in Nigeria. Not limited to it.
landing.countryReadyBody: We're starting in Nigeria because that's where we are. The platform itself isn't tied to one country though: languages, regions, and compliance settings can all be configured for wherever it's needed next.
